hints.title: Two-Player Zero Sum Interval Formulation
hints.text: Players pick from either boundary end of the remaining piles.

hints.title: Subproblem Gap Reduction
hints.text: Define the maximum net score difference reachable from subarray range i to j.

hints.title: Minimax Recurrence
hints.text: Current player chooses the maximum between taking pile i minus optimal opponent score on (i + 1, j) and taking pile j minus opponent on (i, j - 1).
